record.bible_text: Blessed<WH0835> <FI>is<Fi> the man<WH0376> that walketh<WH01980><WTH8804> not in the counsel<WH06098> of the ungodly<WH07563>, nor standeth<WH05975><WTH8804> in the way<WH01870> of sinners<WH02400>, nor sitteth<WH03427><WTH8804> in the seat<WH04186> of the scornful<WH03887><WTH8801>. <RF>ungodly: or, wicked<Rf>
But his delight<WH02656> <FI>is<Fi> in the law<WH08451> of the LORD<WH03068>; and in his law<WH08451> doth he meditate<WH01897><WTH8799> day<WH03119> and night<WH03915>.

And he shall be like a tree<WH06086> planted<WH08362><WTH8803> by the rivers<WH06388> of water<WH04325>, that bringeth forth<WH05414><WTH8799> his fruit<WH06529> in his season<WH06256>; his leaf<WH05929> also shall not wither<WH05034><WTH8799>; and whatsoever he doeth<WH06213><WTH8799> shall prosper<WH06743><WTH8686>. <RF>wither: Heb. fade<Rf><CM>
The ungodly<WH07563> <FI>are<Fi> not so: but <FI>are<Fi> like the chaff<WH04671> which the wind<WH07307> driveth away<WH05086><WTH8799>.
Therefore the ungodly<WH07563> shall not stand<WH06965><WTH8799> in the judgment<WH04941>, nor sinners<WH02400> in the congregation<WH05712> of the righteous<WH06662>.
For the LORD<WH03068> knoweth<WH03045><WTH8802> the way<WH01870> of the righteous<WH06662>: but the way<WH01870> of the ungodly<WH07563> shall perish<WH06><WTH8799>.<CM>
